steps.title: The Map tab
steps.body: The Inspector on the right has three tabs: Inspector (what is selected), Map (terrain, sky, weather, music) and Project (title, start map, hero, first screen).

steps.title: Generate terrain
steps.body: The terrain generator builds a whole world from environments (forest, city, mountains, volcanoes…). Pick one or more, then Generate. New seed gives a different world with the same mix. Houses, trees and cars become assets you can move, smash and edit.

steps.title: Move the camera
steps.body: Drag in the map to orbit, right-drag (or Shift-drag) to pan, and use the wheel to zoom. On a touch screen: one finger orbits, two fingers pan and pinch. Home fits the whole map, F frames the selection.
steps.task: Orbit and zoom the camera, then press Next.
steps.tip: Home fits the map in view.

steps.title: Select an object
steps.body: With the Select tool (V), click an object to select all of it — a house, a tree. Shift-click adds to the selection. The Hierarchy on the left lists every object by type.
steps.task: Select a building (click it, or pick one in the Hierarchy).

steps.title: Place an asset
steps.body: The Scene puts whole things into the world: assets (houses, trees, benches, chests), characters, spawn points, zones, sounds and signs. Place (B) puts down the asset you pick in the dock below (Assets): click the ground, or drag its card straight in. Press T to turn it a quarter turn before you put it down. Bricks themselves are built into assets in the Assets screen.

steps.title: Move it
steps.body: With Move (W), drag one of the red, green or blue arrows to move the selection that way, or drag the object itself to slide it along the ground. It is checked only where you drop it, and it settles onto what is below, so a chest on a tower can go straight to the tower’s door.

steps.title: Erase
steps.body: Erase (X) removes the object you click: a whole asset copy, a house, a tree. Things that hold others up are protected so the map never breaks. Single bricks are erased on an asset’s build plate in the Assets screen.
steps.task: Erase an object with the Erase tool (X).

steps.title: Undo and redo
steps.body: Everything you do is one undo step: placing, moving, erasing, generating a whole map. Ctrl Z undoes, Ctrl Shift Z redoes. The project saves itself to this device a moment after each change.
steps.task: Undo your last change (Ctrl Z or the Undo button).
